description: This file provides functions for sending, editing, and deleting messages and cards in Microsoft Teams via the Bot Framework, including handling media uploads, proactive messaging, and conversation management.

methods.name: sendMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Sends a message with optional media to a Teams conversation or user, handling media uploads, consent cards, and inline images based on conversation type and media size.

methods.name: sendPollMSTeams
methods.description: Sends a poll as an Adaptive Card to a Teams conversation or user.

methods.name: sendAdaptiveCardMSTeams
methods.description: Sends an arbitrary Adaptive Card to a Teams conversation or user.

methods.name: editMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Proactively edits a previously sent message in a Teams conversation.

methods.name: deleteMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Proactively deletes a message in a Teams conversation.

methods.name: listMSTeamsConversations
methods.description: Lists all known conversation references for debugging or CLI purposes.
